meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织协作团队跑多轮调研,产出带引用、经质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要一份结论有据可查、经得起追问的深度调研报告。
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-round team research and get a cited, QA-checked report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a deep research report where every claim is cited and verified.

howto.what: 你明确要求研究时,Claude 会进入 ULW-RESEARCH 模式,在回复开头打印 `ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED!`,先跟你确认成果格式,再组建研究团队分轴调查、互相辩论,最终交付每条断言都带引用或验证证明的成果。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求时触发:说出 “ulw-research”、任何 “ulw” 研究措辞、“ultradebate” 等,或明确要求深度研究、超精确调查。普通提问不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下这个问题
say.note: 它会先问你想要 PDF、DOCX 还是别的格式

say.text: 对 X 做一次深度研究,每条结论都要有引用
say.note: 会组队分轴调查并记录过程日志

say.text: 用 ultradebate 研究这个方案,让成员互相质疑
say.note: 有争议的结论还会跑代码验证

howto.what_en: When you explicitly ask for research, Claude enters ULW-RESEARCH mode, prints `ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED!`, confirms the deliverable format, then runs a cooperating team with debate rounds and returns a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit request: “ulw-research”, any “ulw” research wording, “ultradebate”/“hyperdebate”, or a clear ask for deep or ultra-precise investigation. Ordinary questions do not trigger it.

say_en.note: It first asks which output format you want

say_en.text: Do a deep research pass on X with citations for every claim
say_en.note: A team splits the axes and journals the run

say_en.text: Run an ultradebate research on this plan and cross-attack it
say_en.note: Contested claims also get proven by running code
